messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to lock the prioritization matrix for Optimize toolkit onboarding next sprint. Scope: batching heuristics, prefix caching, quant recommendation API, eval-triggered alerts. Who can surface acceptance criteria, customer risks, and rollout constraints?

Emma: I can own batching + caching perf acceptances. Need clarity on target p99 latency SLOs and the cost-savings buckets we care about.

Jason: From ops: we need an enrollment flow for pilot customers, feature flags, and telemetry events. Proposing alpha vs beta tiers so we can gate customers.

Oliver: SRE risk callouts: KV cache eviction behavior, hot-shard amplification, and memory pressure during heavy batching. Rollout should be a canary with rate limits.

Miguel: Customer signals: simple UX — a single "cost vs latency" slider is what customers ask for. Several customers asked for auto-suggested quant profiles (prefer safe defaults).

Priya: Action plan suggestion: build a 2x2 prioritization matrix with axes: customer risk (low/med/high), feature value, eng effort, infra risk. I'll prototype.

Emma: Quick question on quant recs: do we expose per-model recommendations or per-route? For customers with mixed routes, per-route recommendations are necessary.

Jason: Agreed — per-route plus a global override. Also we need the eval-alert UI: types = regression, drift, token-cost-spike. Must tie to slack/email alerts.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria (vote / objections?):
- batching: measurable cost reduction >=15% on pilot workload w/o p99 > SLO + documented knob to tune batch size
- cache: correctness for 99% of cached prefixes; cache invalidation documented + TTL controls
- quant recs: recommended profiles with end-to-end metric degradation <=3% on the customer's key metric or manual opt-out
- eval-triggered alerts: threshold config, sample set support, and alert delivery to slack/email with auto-snooze rules

Oliver: Add infra requirements: rollback hooks + automatic fallback to full-precision model if inference errors spike. Also trace sampling to debug cache misses.

Miguel: Marketing asks: docs + one-pager + a customer integration example (AcmeHealth). Can the engineering team commit to a sample integration?

Emma: Yes — I'll add a perf table and example config snippets. Example config to include in docs:
```
optimize:
  batching:
    mode: prefix-aware
    max_batch_ms: 10
    max_size: 1024
  cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_secs: 3600
  quant_recommendation:
    strategy: per-route
    safety_threshold: 0.03
```

Priya: Timeline proposal: spec PR by Tue (3 days), alpha pilot invite list by Fri, pilot rollout in 2 sprints. Any blockers?

Jason: Legal needs to sign-off on telemetry collection; contracts may require a short amendment. That review could add ~1 week.

Oliver: GPU infra budget needs approval for pilot capacity. I'll ping finance and add to the runbook.

Miguel: I'll confirm AcmeHealth's pilot availability and share their expected traffic profile.

Priya: Great — I'll post the matrix doc after the PR and tag owners. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created doc: https://redwood/drive/optimize-prio-matrix-draft (perm: team)

Emma: :thumbsup:

Jason: :calendar: scheduled internal review Thurs 11:00am

Priya: Thanks everyone — tagging follow-ups: @Emma for perf table, @Oliver for infra runbook, @Jason for pilot flow + legal sync, @Miguel for customer confirmation.

Oliver: Noted. I'll add canary playbook and rollback steps to the PR.

Miguel: Will confirm customer list by EOD Friday.

Priya: Closing thread — will update with PR link.
